initial_cash_note: Deliberately small: production sizes every trade at a fixed $25 regardless of account size (see strategy_spec.json), so there is no natural 'account equity' to compare against. $100 = 3 concurrent $25 positions + a small buffer, chosen so total-return% reflects return on capital actually put at risk rather than an arbitrary large bankroll diluting the percentage. Override with --initial-cash if you want a different bankroll-relative return.
